# `median`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
median(col)
```

Returns the median of numeric or ANSI interval column `col`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- median, example 1
> SELECT median(col) FROM VALUES (0), (10) AS tab(col);
5.0
```

```sql
-- median, example 2
> SELECT median(col) FROM VALUES (INTERVAL '0' MONTH), (INTERVAL '10' MONTH) AS tab(col);
0-5
```
